quests.title: Step over one blocked cell
quests.ask: Write `go_around()`: facing a blocked cell in the bottom lane, climb up, pass it, and come back down just beyond it, facing east again.
quests.nudge: Trace it with your finger. Where must the robot stand, and which way must it face, when it's done?

quests.title: A block right away
quests.ask: Here the very first cell ahead is blocked. Get past it and walk to the far end of the bottom lane, facing east.
quests.nudge: At every step the robot has two choices. Which one does it need here?

quests.title: A block near the end
quests.ask: Now the blocked cell is just before the end. Finish on the far end of the bottom lane, facing east, without bumping the outer wall.
quests.nudge: A detour carries the robot across more than one column. How many rounds does the walk need then?
